semantics: first-to-terminal existing scrapes only; includes stopping/draining/disconnection, not an active-only interval
histogram delta only when both same-label series exist and are monotone; absent is unknown, never assumed zero
presence lookup count measures observed completed batches, items and groups are observed per-batch totals; a UID may occur repeatedly across batches
scrapes and separate counters/histograms are not transactional, so total and histogram count can differ slightly
transport duration and service wait/task histogram observations are bounded one-in-32 samples from transport observer aggregation; sampled mean is not request wall duration or P99
client/service/wait means describe different samples and cannot be subtracted as an exact request-time decomposition
queue gauges are first/terminal point values, not peaks; terminal 10k-client disconnect is not evidence of active queue overload
8100-P contains profile perturbation; 8100-U lacks final.json and is harness_invalid with prior observed message_loss; no pairwise causal regression conclusion
new terminal-only outcome histogram counts are reported as cumulative point observations, not a first-to-terminal delta; first absence does not establish zero
